interfaceDesign: No new public interface — tests/local-fonts.spec.ts is a Playwright test, not an exported module
FONTS constant array ({family, weight}[]) is the only new identifier, scoped to the test file

selfReview.item: Every public method has an intention-revealing name
selfReview.note: Only new identifier is the test's own title string and the FONTS constant; no new functions introduced

selfReview.item: Cyclomatic complexity < 7 on all new functions
selfReview.note: The test's inline async callbacks have a single conditional each (complexity 2)
family/weight pairs are plain strings matching the CSS Font Loading API's own signature (document.fonts.load(font string)) — wrapping them would fight the platform API, not the domain
Font family/weight pairs are the named FONTS constant, not inlined literals
Font CSS imports sit at the existing side-effect-import site in main.ts, same layer as the existing leaflet.css import

simpleDesign.note: tests/local-fonts.spec.ts passes under --project=chromium locally; reagent-map-globe.spec.ts's no-request test requires the Docker runner image's real-Chrome/WebGL2 context (see notesForQa) and could not be executed in this sandbox
Test name states the exact behavior; FONTS constant names the four family/weight pairs being verified; code comment explains why document.fonts.load is used over .check
Single FONTS array drives all four assertions instead of four repeated blocks
No abstraction added beyond what architecture-notes.md already ruled out (no fonts-loading helper) — direct @fontsource imports at the existing entry-point site
